* `/usr/local/bin/pgpool/has_enough_backends.sh [REQUIRED_NUM_OF_BACKENDS, default=$REQUIRE_MIN_BACKENDS]` - check if there are enough backend behind `pgpool`
* `/usr/local/bin/pgpool/has_write_node.sh` - check if one of the backend can be used as a master with write access
* `gosu postgres repmgr cluster show` - tries to connect to all nodes on request ignore status of node in `$(get_repmgr_schema).$REPMGR_NODES_TABLE`
* `gosu postgres psql $REPLICATION_DB -c "SELECT * FROM $(get_repmgr_schema).$REPMGR_NODES_TABLE"` - just select data from tables

Sirannon, an open source SQLite database library

With Sirannon, you keep SQLite underneath your application as it grows, so the SQL that you write against a file on your laptop keeps working when you serve that file over HTTP and WebSocket or replicate it from a primary to its read replicas. The wire formats, the value encodings, and the replication invariants that every implementation must follow are in the language-agnostic specification under `packages/spec`. The TypeScript package in this repository is the reference implementation of that specification.
Read the documentation, or start the distributed entitlements example on your own machine to watch a three-node cluster keep serving requests after its primary fails.

|Core engine (`@delali/sirannon-db`)|Stable|With the core engine, you get queries, transactions, connection pooling, change data capture, live queries, migrations, backups, hooks, metrics, and a multi-tenant lifecycle. Continuous integration tests it on Node 22 and 24.|

|Server and client (`@delali/sirannon-db/server`, `/client`)|Stable|Applications reach a database over HTTP and WebSocket through the client, which reconnects after a dropped connection and restores its subscriptions. The server rejects SQL from the network until you set `acceptSql: true`.|

|Device sync (`@delali/sirannon-db/client`)|Experimental|A device writes to its own local database first, so it can go on writing while it's offline. The device sync controller then keeps that database in step with a server in both directions, through a push, a live pull, a snapshot resync, and a migration handshake.|

|Primary-replica replication (`@delali/sirannon-db/replication`)|Stable|A primary stamps each change with a Hybrid Logical Clock and sends it to its replicas over gRPC with mutual TLS. The same export also provides conflict resolvers, first sync, and write concerns.|

|Coordinator-backed failover (`/replication/coordinator/etcd`)|Stable|etcd records write authority, primary terms, and the in-sync set. On every pull request, continuous integration executes a Docker conformance suite that injects faults.|
|Drivers|Stable: better-sqlite3, Node, wa-sqlite. Experimental: Bun, Expo|The published package includes TypeScript declarations for all five drivers.|
Sirannon opens each database in SQLite's WAL mode with `synchronous=NORMAL` by default, although you can raise that durability level. Read the roadmap for the next stages of work.

|`create_agent` + `AgentMiddleware`|主 agent、子 agent 都由它搭；16 个自写中间件用到 `before_agent`、`abefore_model`、`awrap_model_call`、`awrap_tool_call`、`after_model`（`can_jump_to`）、`after_agent`|
|`ModelRequest.override(model=…, tools=…)`|每次调模型现挑模型：这一轮定下的、免费额度、直连、备用，出问题一路换下去；这段对话没有资料库时，把查资料库的工具从请求里拿掉|
|`ExtendedModelResponse` + `Command(update=…)`|中间件在一次模型调用里顺手改 state：写上起好的标题、换掉没通过审核的工具结果、记下换上的备用模型、超长重发时记下压到了哪一轮|
|`context_schema` / `ToolRuntime`|取插话、上次起好的标题这些运行时的东西从 context 传给中间件，不进 state；子任务、recall、读写文件、查资料库、看图的工具从 `ToolRuntime` 拿 state 和 context|
|`aupdate_state(as_node=START)` + `astream(None)`|用户的话先写进检查点再开跑，排队时服务重启也不丢|
|`stream_mode=["messages", "updates", "custom"]`，`subgraphs=True`|逐字的思考和正文、存下的步骤、工具进度一路推给页面；子 agent 的流按命名空间认出是哪个子任务的；模型写文件时，从 `tool_call_chunks` 边收边解出标题和正文，右栏跟着出字|
|`get_stream_writer` / `TAG_NOSTREAM`|中间件推自定义事件（在等什么、工具进度、换了哪个模型）；写短版、单条送审这些内部调用不推给页面|
|`content_blocks`|8 家模型的思考统一按标准 content blocks 读；豆包的类标成自家的提供方，才读得到它的思考|
|`with_structured_output(method="function_calling")`|判断难易、起标题这些结构化输出走强制工具调用：DeepSeek 只支持这一种，百炼、TokenHub 上有的接入点也不认 `json_schema`|
|`ContextOverflowError`|各家报的“上下文超长”都认成它，连 MiMo 不报错、一个字没生成就结束的也算；压缩中间件压了再发一次|

|`langchain.mcp`（`MCPAdapter`）|搜索、读网页、天气、地图、航班火车、画图、查文档（Context7）都是 agent-tools 的 MCP 工具，怎么搜、怎么读、挑城市、定地名、查班次、出图存图、结果的样子和失败时给模型的话都在服务里，几个产品共用：灵稿起服务时取来，工具说明后面接上自己的一段，中间件给搜索结果、读到的页、查到的每段文档带上来源 id，管每轮画几张查几次、比路线时核对车站的城市；天气、地图、航班火车、画图结果的 `structuredContent` 画卡片，模型只看文字（图只给编号，页面经灵稿后端按编号取）；排行程是灵稿自己的工具，模型按查到的班次编号排，核对过才画行程卡|
|`ToolMessage.artifact`|子 agent 的整段消息放在 artifact 里交回：来源、用量、子任务卡从这里读，主 agent 的模型只看报告；写文件、查资料库的结果也把给页面的部分放在这里|
|`ToolCallLimitMiddleware`|子 agent 搜、读各 8 次的硬上限|
|`RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter`|资料库切块：先按标题、页分段，再按 800 字切、重叠 100|
|`AsyncPostgresSaver`，`durability="exit"`|检查点只在一轮的开头和结尾存|
|`interrupt(…, response_schema=…)` / `Command(resume={id: …})`|模型问用户：`ask_user` 工具里调 `interrupt`，这次执行结束、线程停在工具里等；回答按中断的 id 交回去，同一轮接着跑，同一条消息里别的工具不重跑；回答的格式由 `response_schema` 校验，不合格的存不进检查点|
|`AsyncPostgresStore`|长期记忆；和检查点、运行记录共用一个连接池|
|LangSmith|评测每次传成一个实验；线上开着 tracing，中间件那几层不记输入输出：每层记的都是同一份请求，一轮问天气就有 1.5MB|
|`StateGraph` + `interrupt`|早先的海报场景：手写图，生成前后停下来让人确认|
